bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; requiring public postsecondary institutions to award the specified college credits for qualifying scores on advanced placement and international baccalaureate examinations; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 120B.13, subdivision 3a; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 135A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 120B.13, subdivision 3a, is amended to read:

Subd. 3a.
College credit.

[-The colleges and universities of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities system must award, and the University of Minnesota and private postsecondary institutions are encouraged to award, college credit to high school students who receive a score of three or higher on an advanced placement or four or higher on the international baccalaureate program examination.-]

[+ The awarding of college credit by a public postsecondary institution for advanced placement and international baccalaureate courses is governed by section 135A.105. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment. +]

Sec. 2.

[+[135A.105] CREDIT FOR ADVANCED PLACEMENT AND INTERNATIONAL BACCALAUREATE PROGRAMS. +]

[+Subdivision 1.+]

[+Applicability.+]

[+This section applies to a public postsecondary institution governed by the Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities or the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota. +]

[+Subd. 2.+]

[+Examination scores and credits required.+]

[+(a) A public postsecondary institution must award college credit as provided in paragraph (b) to high school students who receive a score of three or higher on an advanced placement examination or four or higher on the international baccalaureate examination. +]

[+(b) A public postsecondary institution must award: +]

[+(1) three or more course credits for a score of four or higher on each individual standard level international baccalaureate examination; +]

[+(2) five or more course credits for a score of four or higher on each individual higher level international baccalaureate examination; and +]

[+(3) three or more course credits for a score of three or higher on each individual advanced placement examination. +]

[+EFFECTIVE DATE.+]

[+This section is effective the day following final enactment and applies to advanced placement or international baccalaureate examinations taken on or after January 1, 2026. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to higher education; requiring public postsecondary institutions to award the specified college credits for qualifying scores on advanced placement and international baccalaureate examinations; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 120B.13, subdivision 3a; proposing coding for new law in Minnesota Statutes, chapter 135A.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 120B.13, subdivision 3a, is amended to read:

Subd. 3a.
College credit.

The awarding of college credit by a public postsecondary institution for advanced placement and international baccalaureate courses is governed by section 135A.105.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment.

Sec. 2.

[135A.105] CREDIT FOR ADVANCED PLACEMENT AND INTERNATIONAL BACCALAUREATE PROGRAMS.

Subdivision 1.

Applicability.

This section applies to a public postsecondary institution governed by the Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities or the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota.

Subd. 2.

Examination scores and credits required.

(a) A public postsecondary institution must award college credit as provided in paragraph (b) to high school students who receive a score of three or higher on an advanced placement examination or four or higher on the international baccalaureate examination.

(b) A public postsecondary institution must award:

(1) three or more course credits for a score of four or higher on each individual standard level international baccalaureate examination;

(2) five or more course credits for a score of four or higher on each individual higher level international baccalaureate examination; and

(3) three or more course credits for a score of three or higher on each individual advanced placement examination.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective the day following final enactment and applies to advanced placement or international baccalaureate examinations taken on or after January 1, 2026.

This section applies to a public postsecondary institution governed by the Board of Trustees of the Minnesota State Colleges and Universities or the Board of Regents of the University of Minnesota.

(a) A public postsecondary institution must award college credit as provided in paragraph (b) to high school students who receive a score of three or higher on an advanced placement examination or four or higher on the international baccalaureate examination.
(b) A public postsecondary institution must award:
(1) three or more course credits for a score of four or higher on each individual standard level international baccalaureate examination;
(2) five or more course credits for a score of four or higher on each individual higher level international baccalaureate examination; and
(3) three or more course credits for a score of three or higher on each individual advanced placement examination.
This section is effective the day following final enactment and applies to advanced placement or international baccalaureate examinations taken on or after January 1, 2026.
